response.sql: WITH driver_counts AS (SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS qualifying_records FROM qualifying GROUP BY driverId), driver_average AS (SELECT AVG(qualifying_records) AS average_records FROM driver_counts) SELECT dc.driverId, dc.qualifying_records, dc.qualifying_records * 1.0 / da.average_records AS ratio_to_average FROM driver_counts AS dc CROSS JOIN driver_average AS da ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, dc.driverId LIMIT 10;
